name: Koumura Kazuto
source:
A regular teen who met [url=/c12620]Ilmi[/url] 10 years ago.

After a certain accident, he started transforming into a monster whose sexual desires aren't easily satisfied.

Now, after reuniting with her, what kind of daily life are the two of them going to live?
